https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/5/fel.summary_original: The "old" version of Cowork runs model inference in the cloud, executing tool calls in an Anthropic-provided VM we shipped to your computer. https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/5/fel.summary_zh: Anthropic 工程师 Felix Rieseberg 说明 Cowork 的新旧架构差异：旧版在云端推理、在用户电脑上运行本地 VM，磁盘、电池和性能开销大，合上笔记本工作就停止。 新版把模型推理和 VM 都移到云端，每个会话有独立沙盒，桌面应用只负责文件访问等需要本机设备的工具调用，官方认为这解决了手机使用、保持工作运行和电池消耗等问题。

https://the-decoder.com/ai-agents-overst.summary_original: Epoch AI and Anthropic independently found the same thing: current AI models like GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5 can run experiments but lack scientific self-criticism and genuine creative thinking. At best, Sol reached 15 percent of the human reference score, and even that came from methods researchers already knew. https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/10/05/.summary_original: Reka has released a research preview of Rho-1 , a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch.
